summary: MaintCourseDetailsPlacementHistory is a user control in the HSPnet system, designed to display and manage placement history details for a given course. It interfaces with a data source and provides a grid view of placements, with sorting and conditional data retrieval based on user session and course context.
purpose: To present a course's placement history in a sortable grid, ensuring data visibility is conditioned on user authentication/session and the specified course ID. Used within web pages to support administrative review and management.

fields.name: uxMaster
fields.purpose: Displays placement history data in a grid

fields.name: CourseID
fields.purpose: Identifies the course for which placement history is shown

workflows.name: Page Load
steps: Triggered when the user control loads
If not a postback, sorts the GridView (uxMaster) by TTStartDate descending

workflows.name: Data Selection
steps: If valid, sets input parameters for session and courseID, enabling secure and scoped data retrieval

business_rules: Placement history should only be visible when there is a valid UserSession.
Placement data is filtered by CourseID.
validations: UserSession must not be null to retrieve placement data.
calculations: GridView (uxMaster) is sorted by TTStartDate in descending order on initial load.
conditions: Data is only retrieved if UserSession exists.
Data is filtered by CourseID parameter.
system_behavior: Auto-generates UI fields for Panel, Label, GridView, and ObjectDataSource.
Cancels ObjectDataSource selection if UserSession is not valid.
exceptions: Selection is cancelled (e.Cancel = true) if UserSession is missing.
content_gaps: No details about what fields are displayed in the GridView beyond sort key (TTStartDate).
No explicit mapping of placement fields, business logic for row selection, or error handling beyond session validation.
